paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc is 5.5, with a 2.04% increase from the prior close and a 27.63% decrease over 22 sessions. The price quote is as of September 11, 2026.

There are no new news headlines in the last 24 hours, but a recent news article from Stock Titan on September 11, 2026, reports that the largest shareholder group of Fermi Inc, owning about 22% of the company, is pressing for a deal review. The group proposes hiring an independent bank to weigh sale or recap options and easing voting and REIT limits.

Recent SEC filings include a PX14A6G form on September 11, 2026, and a form 3 on September 3, 2026, as well as an 8-K form on August 31, 2026, which scheduled the company's first annual meeting of stockholders. There have also been insider transaction reports, with two form 4 filings on August 27 and August 18, 2026.
